content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: the \"Trades\" nav control gives no visible response to a click, so users click it again while the menu's \"IR Swap\" item and the overlay-then-navigation sequence (about 0.3 s after the overlay appears) are still pending; in the cited windows, Trades clicks are followed by no navigation, overlay, or error event until the menu item is selected.", "fix": "Fix: On the ir swap:screen top navigation, make the \"Trades\" trigger (the span labelled Trades) show an immediate expanded state (aria-expanded plus a visible chevron or open-menu highlight) on its first click, and do not toggle the menu closed on a repeat click within the first few seconds.", "cited_event_ids": ["41", "47", "54", "56", "61:w62", "63", "68:w77", "78", "88", "93:w112", "app:6", "app:8"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["What the Trades control does on click (menu toggle, navigation, or other) is not shown in the events.", "The insight's 'no visible state change' claim is not directly visible in the events; the windows show only clicks, focus, pointer samples, and no DOM state.", "Whether the repeated clicks are caused by lack of feedback or by the menu closing on re-click is not established.", "The overlay and navigation are only observed after the IR Swap menu item is clicked, so the link between Trades clicks and the later navigation is inferred from ordering only.", "Pointer samples were dropped (90, 141, 127 dropped in the three sessions), so pointer movement between clicks is incomplete."]}
